an6.4:1.3: saddhābalena viriyabalena satibalena samādhibalena paññābalena āsavānañca khayā anāsavañcetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
an6.4:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
